reason: An agent workflow guard that detects repeated or failed experiments, requires a structured blocker review, and temporarily restricts non-investigative tool calls before allowing further attempts.

summaries.zh: 一个面向智能体执行流程的防重复尝试插件，会在连续失败或重复实验后要求复盘卡点并限制非调查性工具调用。
summaries.en: An agent workflow guard that prompts blocker analysis after repeated or failed experiments and temporarily restricts non-investigative tool calls.

capabilities: Monitors failed and repeated tool calls
Injects investigative questions into agent steps
Denies non-investigative tool calls while a gate is pending
Allows a configured subset of investigative tools
Resets gating counters after a new user problem
Validates threshold configuration at plugin load
